analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement, but the price is still low relative to SMA200 (-22.51%) despite 5 consecutive days of gains. Volume is normal with a ratio of 1.06 to the 5-day average. The 52-week position is 5.4%, near historical lows. 4-hour RSI is 51.8 in the neutral zone, and weekly ADX at 21.8 indicates an early stage of trend formation. The price is consolidating around the 0.236 Fibonacci retracement level ($0.98). ATR at 5.75% suggests moderate volatility. The price is trading between the 5-day low ($0.89) and high ($1.02), and the 20-day low ($0.87) and high ($1.17), indicating a sideways trend. Key support is at $0.89 and resistance at $1.13. The price is currently at the middle band of the Bollinger Bands ($0.98). CCI is -34.0, and Stochastic %K is 53.4, %D is 44.6. Weekly RSI is 35.7, and weekly MACD histogram is -0.0329. ADX is 37.5 with -DI (27.6) higher than +DI (19.3), suggesting a downtrend is still more dominant despite recent price action. The 5-day daily price change shows significant fluctuations: +0.79%, +0.64%, +1.36%, -1.62%, +1.32%. External factors like SEC lawsuits and partnerships are not considered.
